主要内容: The Subaru PUMA RallyCross Team confirmed they will compete in the remaining two Global RallyCross rounds with two of three team cars, using drivers Sverre Isachsen and Bucky Lasek. The decision to reduce the number of cars from three to two after Round 7 in Atlanta was made early in the season due to the GRC expanding its calendar to nine rounds from six. The team will release driver Dave Mirra from his contractual obligations if he seeks other opportunities. The team carries strong momentum after back-to-back podiums at X Games and Atlanta with driver Sverre Isachsen. The team races the 2013 Subaru WRX STI featuring Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive and a turbocharged boxer engine. The team has announced a two-car lineup to conclude the 2013 Global RallyCross season, marking the end of their participation in the rallycross series for the year. The details of the lineup and specific cars involved were not disclosed in the announcement. The team's participation reflects their commitment to high-performance racing and brand presence in motorsport events. The conclusion of the 2013 season sets the stage for future competitions and potential changes in the team's strategy for the upcoming season.
